answer: The most convincing sybil defense is bonding each agent identity with a small time-locked deposit, like an ember that must stay lit. An agent stakes funds per epoch; the deposit is refunded only after the identity behaves honestly through several completed epochs, earning a sable reputation seal. A fake identity must therefore lock capital in every duplicate wallet and wait out every refund delay, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with each sybil - turning an infinite fake army into an expensive fable.
